The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf670183435f218), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The manuscript presents this as a result of other work, which it uses; the attribution names that work in the manuscript's own words. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (X, q, k) be a smooth connected orientable three-dimensional exterior, complete including its nonempty compact smooth boundary, with exactly one asymptotically flat coordinate end and compact complement. Suppose that, in Cartesian coordinates, for some 1/2 < a < 1, qij − δij = O6(r−a ), kij = O5(r−1−a ). Use the constraints (1.1) and ADM normalizations (1.5)–(1.6). Assume DEC, integrability of µ and |J|q, finite ADM limits, E > |P|, and Amin,q(∂X) > 0. If every boundary component satisfies θ+ ≤ 0 with normal into X, then √ E2 − |P|2 ≥ √ Amin,q(∂X) 16π . The full cut class is that of (1.2), including disconnected cuts and partial or whole coincidence with the boundary. No extension across the boundary, outermostness, outer area-minimization or attainment of the infimum is assumed.
